svg.title: Freeze the body, train the sliver
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Freeze the body, train the sliver” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A diagram split by a dashed line: on the left a hachured padlocked ResNet stack of 11.7 million frozen parameters under a small bright Linear head of 2,052 trainable parameters, 0.018 percent of the model; on the right thirty-two hachured frozen Llama layers totalling 6.74 billion parameters with thin LoRA B and A adapter pairs beside four of them at 0.25 percent, joined by a fat double-headed arrow labelled SAME THING, plus a small chart where the feature-extraction and full-fine-tuning curves cross at about seven hundred images.
svg.text: Freeze the body, train the sliver
draw it from memory, then compare
